_comment: Tank survival thresholds for TBC raid bosses (level 73). Values are rating unless noted.

crit_immune.notes: 490 defense = crit immune vs bosses. No defense talents in standard prot build.

crush_immune.method: Shield Block ability pushes crushes off the attack table when active.
crush_immune.notes: Miss + Dodge + Parry + Block >= 102.4% with Shield Block up. Base miss vs 73 = 5%.

health_baseline.notes: Unbuffed HP. Raid buffed adds ~2-3k from kings, fort, etc.

armor_baseline.notes: Armor values in bear form or with shield. 75% cap at ~35880.

crit_immune.notes: 490 defense = crit immune vs bosses. Paladins can also use resilience from PvP gear.

crush_immune.method: Holy Shield adds 30% block chance. Need total avoidance + block >= 102.4% with Holy Shield.
crush_immune.notes: Miss(5%) + Dodge + Parry + Block + Holy Shield(30%) >= 102.4%. More achievable than warriors in early gear.

health_baseline.notes: Paladins run slightly lower HP than warriors. Spell damage for threat is also important.

crit_immune.notes: SotF reduces crit chance taken by 3%. Only need 415 defense (65 above base) instead of 490. Can also use resilience: ~103 rating covers the remaining 2.6%.

crush_immune.method: Bears cannot receive crushing blows in bear form (game mechanic).
crush_immune.notes: Not applicable. Bears are inherently crush-immune.

health_baseline.notes: Bear form HP with dire bear multiplier. Bears compensate for no block/parry with massive HP and armor.

armor_baseline.notes: Dire Bear Form armor multiplier makes bears the highest-armor tanks. Leather armor * 4.7 modifier.
